changelog:
bing-webmaster-helper 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides direct integration with Bing Webmaster Tools API using an API key (no verification file upload required).
- Enables instant single or batch URL submission for fast Bing indexing of verified sites.
- Supports fetching search traffic, keyword rankings, indexing, crawl health, and submission quota data.
- Allows full Markdown SEO report generation combining all metrics, ready for automated sharing.
- Designed for seamless audit automation/scheduling with workspace scheduler integration.
